title: OGC API Tiles: one vector tile, one raster tile with a pixel oracle, one empty tile
promise: A customer fetches tiles of a published collection through the SDK's OGC API Tiles client and gets the fixture polygon where the fixture says it is.

steps.description: Fetch the painted tile as a Mapbox vector tile; it holds exactly the fixture polygon, at the projected fixture bounds.
Fetch the painted tile as PNG; sample pixels inside the fixture polygon are painted and pixels outside are transparent.
Fetch a tile no fixture feature intersects; the SDK reports an empty tile.

honua-sdk-dotnet.vector-tile: (no OGC API Tiles client in Honua.Sdk)
honua-sdk-dotnet.raster-tile: (no OGC API Tiles client in Honua.Sdk)
honua-sdk-dotnet.empty-tile: (no OGC API Tiles client in Honua.Sdk)
